name: markdown-viewer
description: Un visor de Markdown mínimo para Windows, Linux y macOS.

scripts.test: pnpm test:release && pnpm check:ipc && pnpm test:frontend && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: pnpm check:version && pnpm check:e2e && pnpm check:ipc && pnpm build:frontend && node --check scripts/frontend.mjs && node --check scripts/package-arch.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path scripts/ipc-contract/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path scripts/ipc-contract/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check:ipc: cargo run --locked --manifest-path scripts/ipc-contract/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --locked --manifest-path scripts/ipc-contract/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm build:frontend && node scripts/test-frontend.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.tests.json && node --test tests/*.test.ts
